about: Held-out fictional job ads, written on 2026-11-11 after the rule fixes and never used to tune them. Same gold conventions as job-records.json. The author had seen the rules, so this set is less independent than one written by someone else; it still shows how far the fixes generalise beyond the misses they were written for.

job.title: Graduate Software Engineer
job.description: Our 2027 graduate intake starts in February. You'll rotate across platform and product squads. We offer a hybrid model with two days a week in our Docklands office. Starting salary $78,000 plus 11.5% superannuation. You must have full working rights in Australia.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description: Build dbt models and Airflow pipelines for our clinical data platform. Salary range $130k - $150k + super depending on experience.

job.title: Intelligence Analyst
job.description: Applicants must be Australian citizens and able to obtain and maintain an NV2 clearance. This position is located in our Russell office and cannot be performed remotely. APS6 $103,421 – $114,536 per annum.

job.title: Frontend Developer
job.description: Work on React and TypeScript apps for retail clients. We're remote-friendly but most of the team is in the office Monday to Wednesday. $95,000 to $110,000 depending on experience. Sponsorship is not available for this role.

job.title: Staff Accountant
job.description: Reconcile intercompany accounts and support month-end close. This is an in-office position five days per week. Pay range: $62,000-$70,000 annually.

items.notes: 'Staff Accountant' is not a staff-level (lead) role.

job.title: Principal Cloud Engineer
job.description: Set the AWS landing zone strategy for 40 product teams. Flexible working with WFH Mondays and Fridays. Package $230,000 - $260,000 including super.

job.title: Customer Support Specialist
job.description: Help small businesses get the most out of our invoicing app over chat and phone. $28 - $32 per hour. Casual, 20 to 30 hours a week.

job.title: Solutions Architect
job.description: Design integration patterns for our payments modernisation. You will need to hold or be willing to obtain a Baseline clearance. Daily rate $1,200 - $1,350 inc super, 12-month contract.

job.title: Marketing Coordinator
job.description: Coordinate cellar-door events and our social channels. Salary from $65,000 plus super and a generous wine allowance.

job.title: Machine Learning Researcher
job.description: Publish and ship research on retrieval models. We sponsor Skilled Worker visas for this role. Salary £85,000 - £110,000 plus equity. Hybrid: 3 days a week in our King's Cross office.

job.title: Junior Data Analyst
job.description: Support the merchandise team with weekly sales reporting in SQL and Excel. This role is based in our Adelaide support office. Australian citizens or permanent residents only. $70k + super.

items.notes: 'This role is based in our ... office' is on-site.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Platform
job.location: Melbourne VIC or remote in Australia
job.description: Lead two platform teams of six engineers. Remote working is available anywhere in Australia, with travel to Melbourne once a quarter. Base salary $210,000 – $235,000.

items.notes: Location says remote; the gold reads remote rather than hybrid because remote is offered outright.

job.title: Summer Vacation Program – Actuarial
job.description: A paid ten-week vacation program for penultimate-year students. You'll join our pricing team in the office. Open to Australian citizens and permanent residents.

items.notes: 'join our pricing team in the office' is not a firm on-site statement; left empty.

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer
job.description: Run our Kubernetes fleet and own incident response. On-call one week in five. Our team works hybrid. Remuneration: $150,000 to $170,000 + super + on-call allowance.

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description: Grow our freight accounts across South East Queensland. Base $110,000 + super, OTE $160,000 with uncapped commission. Car allowance provided.

items.notes: OTE includes commission and is not salary.

job.title: Software Developer
job.description: Maintain the council's planning permit system in C# and SQL Server. Applicants must be eligible to work in Australia. Band 6: $92,500 – $101,300 p.a. plus 12% super. A hybrid working arrangement is available after probation.

job.title: Product Analyst
job.description: Turn claims journey data into product decisions. We operate a citizenship-neutral hiring policy and welcome all applicants with valid work rights. This is a work from home role with occasional team days.

job.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
job.description: Join our two-year graduate program working across substations and solar farms. This role is fly-in fly-out on a 2/1 roster. $80,000 base + super + site allowances.

job.title: Backend Engineer (Go)
job.description: Build the ledger services behind our merchant wallet. Hybrid working with 2 office days. Monthly base S$7,000 - S$9,500. Employment Pass sponsorship available for strong candidates.

job.title: Senior UX Researcher
job.description: Plan and run research for our banking clients. You'll mentor two junior researchers. Up to $165k + super. No visa sponsorship is offered.

job.title: Warehouse Team Leader
job.description: Lead a pick-and-pack team of 12 on afternoon shift. This is an onsite role at our Dandenong distribution centre. $34.80/hr plus shift penalties.

job.title: Policy Officer
job.description: Draft briefings on social housing supply. Flexible work options including working from home part of the week. Salary $88,000 – $96,000 per annum. Applicants must hold Australian citizenship.

job.title: Associate Consultant
job.description: Support ERP implementation projects for public-sector clients. Some client work requires Australian citizenship. Competitive salary and a structured training plan.

items.notes: Ambiguous: only some client work requires citizenship. Gold follows the stated requirement.

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description: Build forecasting models for retail clients. Salary: $105,000 - $125,000 CAD. Hybrid, two days a week in our downtown office. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada.
